messages.content: I’ll commit a DA arbitrage position using the lowest-priced charging hours and the afternoon and evening peaks, then revisit the physical schedule at each watch as RT prices and notices arrive.

The battery is full, and late-morning RT prices have been below DA prices. The extra afternoon-to-evening cycle has only a thin margin at DA prices, so I’ll cancel it and hold the energy for the evening sale. The DA position remains unchanged.

RT prices stayed low through the afternoon, supporting the decision to skip the extra cycle. I’ll retain the scheduled 19:00 sale and 23:00 recharge; both remain feasible and leave the required ending SoC.
